svg.title: dario quick start: install, log in, start the proxy, point a tool at it
svg.desc: Terminal transcript. $ npm install -g @askalf/dario $ dario login $ dario proxy $ export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3456 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=dario $ aider --model sonnet # or cline, zed, continue, claude, your own script — the proxy prints: Your Claude subscription is now an API, with ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3456 and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=dario.
svg.text: Run `dario proxy` to start the API proxy.
Your Claude subscription is now an API.
Pool: 1 account (a pool of one) — add more with `dario accounts add <alias>` to load-balance
aider --model sonnet # or cline, zed, continue, claude, your own script
